placeholders.label: Lockdown Access Screening Process
placeholders.description: Facility-specific process for screening or authorizing entry during lockdown while preserving required egress.
placeholders.example_value: assigned staff screen entrants at the main entrance, verify role and need, log entry, and escalate concerns to the command center

placeholders.label: Staff Call-Down Process
placeholders.description: Facility-specific process, tool, or list used to notify off-duty staff and request disaster staffing support.
placeholders.example_value: department call trees and the emergency notification system maintained by nursing administration

placeholders.label: Disaster Staffing Options
placeholders.description: Facility-specific staffing sources, reassignment options, agency contacts, or contingency staffing methods used during disaster operations.
placeholders.example_value: off-duty staff call-in, department reassignment, contracted agency staff, approved volunteers, and leadership redeployment

placeholders.label: Staff Sheltering Locations
placeholders.description: Facility-specific pre-designated locations where staff may rest, sleep, or shelter during extended emergency operations.
placeholders.example_value: training room, chapel overflow area, and designated vacant resident rooms when available

placeholders.label: Staff Sheltering Setup Owner Title
placeholders.description: Facility title or department responsible for setting up staff sheltering/rest areas.
placeholders.example_value: Environmental Services Supervisor

placeholders.label: Staff Sheltering Alternate Locations
placeholders.description: Facility-specific alternate off-site or community locations that may support staff sheltering when on-site space is not sufficient.
placeholders.example_value: local hotels, community shelters, or partner facilities contacted by administration

placeholders.label: Staff Sheltering Partner Agreements
placeholders.description: Facility-specific MOUs, informal partner contacts, or agreement status for staff sheltering, lodging, or support.
placeholders.example_value: current lodging and sheltering agreements listed in the emergency contact/resource directory
